import ast,hashlib,json,re,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
ns={'__name__':'skill_contract_functions','__file__':str(root/'scripts/validate_skills.py')}
exec(compile((root/'scripts/validate_skills.py').read_text(),str(root/'scripts/validate_skills.py'),'exec'),ns)
folder=root/'skills/drama/drama-production-planning'
fm=ns['frontmatter']((folder/'SKILL.md').read_text())

assert fm['name']==meta['name']==folder.name
assert meta['category']=='drama' and meta['version']=='0.1.0' and meta['status']=='draft'
assert meta['schema_version']==1 and meta['dependencies']==[]
assert re.fullmatch(r'[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)+',fm['name']) and len(fm['name'])<64
assert len(fm['description'])<=1024
for key in ('summary','input_contract','output_contract'): assert isinstance(meta[key],str) and meta[key].strip()
for key in ('owners','tags'): assert isinstance(meta[key],list) and meta[key] and all(isinstance(x,str) and x.strip() for x in meta[key])
cases=json.loads((folder/'tests/cases.json').read_text())
assert len(cases)==3 and {c['kind'] for c in cases}=={'happy','missing_input','boundary'}
assert len({c['id'] for c in cases})==3
for c in cases:
 assert isinstance(c['prompt'],str) and c['prompt'].strip()
 assert isinstance(c['expect'],list) and c['expect'] and all(isinstance(x,str) and x.strip() for x in c['expect'])
raw=json.loads((root/'reports/drama-skill-intake/drama-production-planning/raw-prompts.json').read_text())
assert raw==[{'id':c['id'],'prompt':c['prompt']} for c in cases]
errors=[]
for p in folder.rglob('*.md'):
 errors+=ns['link_errors'](p,root)
 assert '/Users/' not in p.read_text(), p
for p in folder.rglob('*.json'): errors+=ns['revision_errors'](json.loads(p.read_text()),str(p.relative_to(root)))
assert not errors,errors
base='8271786fd12cc4a35339d56fb26d8635af50fa0c'
paths=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only',base,'HEAD'],text=True).splitlines()
assert all(p.startswith(('skills/drama/drama-production-planning/','reports/drama-skill-intake/drama-production-planning/')) for p in paths)
assert not subprocess.check_output(['git','status','--porcelain'],text=True).strip()
digests={str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(folder.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()}
print(json.dumps({'status':'pass','scope':'unregistered skill-local structure and relative references','base_commit':base,'head_commit':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'checks':['frontmatter and required metadata','three case kinds and observable assertions','raw prompts exactly match originals','public links resolve inside repo','positive revision values','no author-machine paths in runtime markdown','changed paths within write_scope','clean frozen worktree'],'cases_defined':3,'behavior_cases_executed':0,'registry_and_discovery':'not_run - parent-owned','digests':digests},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
